hints.title: Palindrome Symmetry Across Boundary
hints.text: The concatenated string sub_s + sub_t forms a palindrome when matching outer characters flank a valid palindrome prefix of t or suffix of s.

hints.title: Center Expansion Precomputation
hints.text: Precompute the longest palindrome prefixes of t and palindrome suffixes of s to determine max central expansions.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Table
hints.text: Compute dp[i][j] representing matching characters ending at s[i] and starting at t[j], and combine with precomputed center expansions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Computes prefix and suffix palindrome lengths and combines them with outer matching DP.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force testing all pairs of substrings is far too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DP table of size M by N stores longest matching boundary characters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that the concatenated palindrome can be factored into outer matching characters and a middle palindrome.
